supporting_observations.claim: The account ext.rwong was created at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake, about two minutes after the alert's approximate time.
The account-creation event was associated with nora.blake's network logon from WS-NBLAKE-01, recorded shortly beforehand.
Immediately after creation, ext.rwong was added to the Freelancers group. This matches the stated help-desk process for temporary ext.<name> accounts.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for the proxy host were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the account creation. Proxy activity during that interval cannot be assessed from those logs.
The available records do not show whether the account was subsequently used or whether an account request was approved.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish a business request or approval for ext.rwong.
The observed addition to Freelancers does not establish whether the account had any other group memberships or privileges.
The evidence does not establish whether ext.rwong was used after creation.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe was launched on WS-NBLAKE-01 and loaded a validly signed Cisco module. The inventory states there is no VPN; this is a separate item to review and is not evidence that the account creation was malicious. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)
